sourceNote: PRIMARY MEASURED STUDY: the TCGplayer Authentication Center opened more than 8,000 Lost Origin packs (September 2022) and published per-pack rates. Their figures: Ultra Rare 19.95% overall = normal V 11.63% (1 in 9), VMAX/VSTAR 4.42% (1 in 23), full-art V 1.98% (1 in 51), full-art Trainer 1.42% (1 in 70), alt-art V 0.50% (1 in 201); Radiant Rare 5.01% (1 in 20); Secret Rare 2.05% (1 in 49) = rainbow 1.28% + gold 0.76%; Trainer Gallery 12.31%. Mapped onto this catalog's tiers by INSPECTING which cards each tier holds. double_rare (15 cards) = the 12 normal V PLUS the 3 Radiant Pokemon (Radiant Hisuian Sneasler/Steelix/Gardevoir), so it takes 11.63 + 5.01 = 16.64%. CORRECTION 2026-08-25: this tier previously carried 11.63%, the plain-V rate alone -- the three Radiant cards sat in the tier with their 5.01% slot uncounted, which understated the tier by 5.01 percentage points and understated this set's EV. ultra_rare (32 cards) = plain VMAX/VSTAR plus the #172-196 full-art, alt-art and Trainer range = 19.95 - 11.63 = 8.32%. hyper_rare (21 cards) = the #197+ rainbow and gold range = 2.05%. KNOWN CONSERVATIVE GAP: the 12.31% Trainer Gallery subset (TG01-TG30) is not carried in this catalog, so roughly 12 percentage points of pack contents are unmodelled and this set's EV is UNDERSTATED.
